description: vacation.rs update loop at line 138 uses args.get("update").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) (borrow), making patch: &Value throughout the loop. This forces patch.clone() at lines 148 and 178 even though the function takes args: Value by ownership and could use args-consuming removal (args.remove("update")) to take ownership instead. Not covered by existing issues: JMAP-4ii.26 is mailbox, JMAP-4ii.53 is chat/identity, JMAP-4ii.59 is submission/onSuccessUpdateEmail.
title: vacation.rs update loop borrow forces patch.clone()
